doItems: Verify every employer before presenting them to clients - sponsorship approval status, genuine vacancy, and salary against TSMIT are checked by our team.
Give you an honest eligibility assessment at the free consultation, including telling you clearly if you don't yet qualify for a 482 application.
Work with a MARA registered legal partner in the same office. Insight Idea's Registered Migration Agent (MARN: 1467870) is based at the same Docklands address as RedBridge.
Structure fees across milestones so you pay as outcomes are delivered, not as a single upfront sum before work has begun.
Plan your 186 PR transition from the moment your 482 is granted so you're not scrambling later.
dontItems: We don't send unverified job lists and call it a placement service. Every employer introduction is personal and specific to your profile.
We don't guarantee visa outcomes. No agency legally can, and if one tells you otherwise, that is a red flag worth taking seriously.
We don't take your money if you don't qualify. If your free assessment reveals the pathway isn't achievable, we say so before any fees are discussed.
We don't fabricate work experience to boost your assessment score. False histories fail and can create serious legal consequences.
